keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Delay in match because of an injury Bob Armah (KuPS).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, KuPS. Gustav Engvall replaces Bob Armah because of an injury.
Delay in match because of an injury Johannes Kreidl (KuPS).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
First Half ends, KuPS 0, Gent 0.
Second Half begins KuPS 0, Gent 0.
Taneli Hämäläinen (KuPS) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Momodou Sonko (Gent) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay in match because of an injury Petteri Pennanen (KuPS).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, KuPS. Julius Eskesen replaces Samuel Pasanen.
Substitution, KuPS. Saku Heiskanen replaces Ayman Aiki.
Substitution, Gent. Gilles De Meyer replaces Momodou Sonko.
Substitution, Gent. El Hadji Seck replaces Abdelkahar Kadri.
Substitution, Gent. Kyrell Wilson replaces Josué Vergara.
Substitution, KuPS. Tommi Jyry replaces Piotr Parzyszek.
Tibe De Vlieger (Gent) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Second Half ends, KuPS 0, Gent 0.
